note: He runs his own financial planning and insurance practice, which clears the occupation criterion, and health is unambiguously the neglected area — nothing at all for the last two to three weeks and no methodical training ever. He is not the deconditioned exclusion: he ran regularly, has lost weight recently and is not gym-averse, having stopped only because of a two-hour round trip. Two hard misses. Income: a stated total ceiling of 1k for six months against $6,000, with two jobs and no savings, is the widest capacity gap in the batch. Good-to-great: he rates his own appearance at the bottom of the scale, calls himself still overweight with very small arms and has never trained methodically, which is rescue rather than optimisation. He is closest in shape to the Francisco Vega assessment, except that here the payment plan could not bridge it.
